header: A DIGITAL TIMER for a search that takes a while (the Executive Deep Search answer takes up to about two minutes). I put it in the top right corner of the panel (on the row the window gives it); it ticks while the answer is being looked for, and stops the moment it is drawn, keeping the time it took on screen. Pure display: the caller says when it started and, once it is over, when it stopped. Read by src/components/OmnibarModal.tsx.

symbols.name: formatElapsed
doc: Formats milliseconds as a digital clock: 00:47.312 (minutes, seconds, milliseconds); the leftmost unit is the millisecond, so all three digits after the point are shown

symbols.name: spokenElapsed
doc: The same, in words for a screen reader: "47.312 seconds", "1 minute 5.200 seconds"

symbols.name: ElapsedTimer
symbols.sig: export function ElapsedTimer({ startedAt, stoppedAt, now: nowForTest }: { startedAt: number; stoppedAt: number | null; now?: number })

params.name: { startedAt, stoppedAt, now: nowForTest }
params.type: { startedAt: number; stoppedAt: number | null; now?: number }

behaviours: the clock face is minutes:seconds.milliseconds (the leftmost unit is the millisecond, three digits)
a clock never runs backwards (a negative span shows zero) and an hour is still readable
spoken for a screen reader: seconds, and minutes with their plural
ticking: shows the time since the start, marked running, with a pulsing dot, as a timer for a screen reader
stopped: shows exactly the time it took (the clock of now is ignored), marked stopped, with a check mark, and no pulsing dot

the chip is in the normal flow (no absolute or zero-height strip), has a height of its own, and does not shrink: the window gives it a row, so it can never lie over a button of the reply (the overlap of 23 Nov)
it says in words what it is: Searching while it ticks, Answered in when it has stopped
digits do not jiggle as they change (tabular figures, a fixed-width face)

the window runs the clock for EVERY search that loads (typed and sent with Enter, or pressed among the samples; the engine, the model or the deep synthesis): it starts when the search starts loading and stops in the render that ends the loading; a run again for the same words within 1.5 s goes on from its first start

the timer is drawn in a ROW at the top of the results panel for any search (not only the deep one), while it runs and frozen beside the reply, and not beside an old answer once the box text has changed (isStale)

the row is in the flow, NOT sticky (it scrolls away with the reply), compact (min-h 2.5rem, py-1), with 'All sample questions' at the left and the timer at the right, both centred on one line (items-center), and it is there for a typed question too (no back link needed)
each back button is drawn once, in that row, and nowhere else (to the shelf, and the plain Back)
a ticking timer redraws once per screen frame (so the millisecond digits run smoothly) and cancels the loop when it stops or the panel goes
the dark face is a real colour (a bg-[#...] class), not an opacity variant of the project's neutral palette, which draws nothing here
